title: Context Clues
subject: Language Arts
description: Stuck on a word? The sentence gives you clues!
steps: Context clues are hints in the sentence that help you figure out a new word.
Read the WHOLE sentence — the other words tell you what makes sense.
Sometimes the sentence explains the word: 'The mango was ENORMOUS — it was bigger than my head!'
Pictures are clues too. Be a word detective: clue + guess + check!

questions.correct: Hints in the sentence that explain a word

questions.prompt: 'The puppy was TIMID — it hid behind the chair, afraid.' What does timid mean?
questions.hint: The clue: it hid because it was afraid.

questions.prompt: 'The fruit was DELICIOUS — everyone wanted more!' Delicious means...
